test.assert_ast_digest_algorithm: Parse test bytes with ast.parse; collect ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False) for each ast.Assert in ast.walk traversal order; serialize that list with json.dumps(items, separators=(',', ':')) using Python default ensure_ascii=True; SHA256 of UTF-8 encoded serialization, with no added newline.

test.alternate_digest_algorithm: SHA256 of the same ast.dump strings joined with one newline between items, UTF-8 encoded, without a trailing newline. This is root's separate serialization, not the encoding of assert_ast_sha256 above.

causal_boundaries.source: Existing accepted() fixture uses explicit simulated native evaluation OS boundary, but real source AttemptRef, SQLite, lifecycle, compute and effect receipts. It is not a real training or scientific result.
causal_boundaries.target: Actual public evaluator.run_post_scripts executes on a controller thread using its own real open_existing_lake connection. Actual Popen, native action, accounting, transaction and terminal functions run unchanged.
causal_boundaries.accelerator: Only inherited GPU allocation/availability boundary doubles remain; no GPU, model, paid provider or live workload.
causal_boundaries.closure: setsid + double fork + execve with empty environment retains the actual output FD. A private AF_UNIX channel uses SO_PEERCRED and pidfd_open before releasing leader exit. Writable inode and live pidfd are checked before publication observations.
causal_boundaries.observability: record_compute_terminal is a transparent observer that always calls the actual implementation. It does not manufacture or mock tree closure.
causal_boundaries.cleanup: Popen root pidfds captured immediately; real prepared worker pidfd captured at READY if supervision is used. All fixture signals address captured own pidfds only. Test temporarily enables own subreaper and restores it. No host scan, PGID or environment-based kill.
causal_boundaries.bounded_wait: After leader exit the test allows up to two seconds for the old synchronous controller to finish while keeping the writer alive. It then closes the daemon through the private channel and waits up to five seconds for real controller completion. Frozen baseline reached the intended assertions, and every test completed cleanup.
causal_boundaries.reuse: Imports only existing fixture helpers/worker text without changing earlier tests or supervision fixtures. Parent source simulation is explicitly replaced by real prepare_supervised and Popen for the target.
